caption: Figure 2. Source composition of the top 100 candidates by hostRepository, with GitHub star counts. Microsoft/Azure (1,364 stars, ~475k installs/skill avg) and Lark/Feishu (16,323 stars but split across two source identities) together account for 73 of 100 entries. The trust signal mismatch is stark: azure-skills has fewer stars than remotion-dev/skills (4,255) despite 23× the represented install count on the leaderboard.
